790030101.text: Oh, this seems to be a ship... Uh, well, more like half a ship...

790030102.text: But what would half a ship be doing in a place like this? Oh, look! There are some words carved on it. Let's see what they say...

790030103.text: "Though the front half was lost, we've somehow managed to stay afloat on the remaining back half for some time now... Now that's what I call a ship, haha! Unfortunately, most of the ship's load is probably sitting at the bottom of the sea by now..."

790030104.text: "...It seems like... we floated here on the southeast currents? Well, that doesn't matter. The problem that we need to solve right now is how to leave this place..."

790030105.text: Looks to Paimon like they were a group of people who were stranded at sea. It says the "front half was lost"...

790030106.text: Oh, so that must mean this is the "remaining back half"! Whew, what could have possibly caused their ship to break into two like that?

790030107.text: Hmm, it also said that they ended up here by floating on the "southeast currents."

790030108.text: If we follow the way that they came and look for the front half of the ship, maybe we'll find something.

790030109.text: Let's bring the carved wood plank we just read with us, too.

790030110.text: Oh, Paimon gets it. You think these carved words might be some sort of clue.

790030111.text: Makes sense to Paimon! Most of the ship's wood has already started to rot, the carved plank will probably break right off.

790030112.text: Alright, let's snap off that plank and go search for the other half of the ship!

790030201.text: Oh, this seems to be a ship... Uh, well, more like half a ship...

790030202.text: But what would half a ship be doing in a place like this? Oh, look! There are some words carved on it. Let's see what they say...

790030203.text: "We have no idea where we are, but it looks like we've left Inazuma far behind. Ha, I wish I could see the looks on the faces of those Shogunate lackeys!"

790030204.text: "However, there doesn't appear to be a speck of dry land in sight. I'm afraid the boat won't hold up unless we find a place to make anchor soon... We need to think of a way soon."

790030205.text: It seems the boat was full of people that left Inazuma, but then encountered some problems at sea... All they could do is drift with the currents.

790030206.text: It seems that their boat was still intact at that time. Let's keep searching the area for more clues.

790030207.text: Let's bring the carved wood plank we just read with us, too.

790030208.text: Oh, Paimon gets it. You think these carved words might be some sort of clue.

790030209.text: Makes sense to Paimon! Most of the ship's wood has already started to rot, the carved plank will probably break right off.

790030210.text: Alright, let's snap off that plank and go search for the other half of the ship!

subQuests.subQuestName: Search for the other half of the wrecked ship

790030301.text: Hey, this must be the other half of the ship. Let's see... Oh, there's some more words carved here!

790030302.text: "We have no idea where we are, but it looks like we've left Inazuma far behind. Ha, I wish I could see the looks on the faces of those Shogunate lackeys!"

790030303.text: "However, there doesn't appear to be a speck of dry land in sight. I'm afraid the boat won't hold up unless we find a place to make anchor soon... We need to think of a way soon."

790030305.text: The words from each half of the ship are connected.

790030306.text: If we place them together, it reads...

790030307.text: "We have no idea where we are, but it looks like we've left Inazuma far behind. Ha, I wish I could see the looks on the faces of those Shogunate lackeys!"

790030308.text: "However, there doesn't appear to be a speck of dry land in sight. I'm afraid the boat won't hold up unless we find a place to make anchor soon... We need to think of a way soon."

790030309.text: "Though the front half was lost, we've somehow managed to stay afloat on the remaining back half for some time now... Now that's what I call a ship, haha! Unfortunately, most of the ship's load is probably sitting at the bottom of the sea by now..."

790030310.text: "...It seems like... we floated here on the southeast currents? Well, that doesn't matter. The problem that we need to solve right now is how to leave this place..."

790030311.text: Paimon gets it now. These people were transporting something on the boat when they encountered some trouble at sea and ended up drifting here.

790030313.text: No kidding, the boat even broke in half...

790030316.text: Hmm, but the real question is... what were they carrying on the ship?

790030317.text: Why don't we look around some more? *gasp* Maybe we'll find treasure!

790030315.text: Paimon sure hopes so... But the situation sounds like it was pretty dire...
